facts.text: The UA Scholars Award provides a $15,000 scholarship to Alaska high school students who rank in the top 10% of their class at the end of their junior year.

sources.title: UA Scholars | Admissions | University of Alaska Anchorage
sources.quote: The UA Scholars Award is a $15,000 scholarship awarded to Alaska high school students who are in the top 10% of their class at the end of their junior year as determined by their school.
